sentences.text:
Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.29650 Of 2023
Order :

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of respondent No.4 in seizing the vehicle Ashok Ley Land Lorry No.KA 39 8077 of the petitioner under the cover of panchanama dated 09.09.2023 and keeping the vehicle in the custody of respondent No.4 police station in connection with Crime No.73/2023 dated 09.09.2023 as illegal, arbitrary and against the principles of natural justice and violative of Articles 19 (1) (g) of the constitution of India.

2. It is stated that the vehicle of the petitioner i.e., Ashok Ley Land Lorry No.KA 39 8077 was seized under the cover of panchanama dated 09.09.2023 in connection with Crime No.73 of 2023 dated 09.09.2023 of Indrakaran Police Station, Sanga Reddy District.

entities.text: Indrakaran Police Station, Sanga Reddy District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Crime No.73 of 2023, was registered for the offences under Section 420 of IPC and Section 7 of Essential Commodities Act on the complaint lodged by SI of Police, Indrakaran, Police Station stating that he received credible information about illegal BVR,J W.P.No.29650 OF 2023 transportation of PDS rice in the vehicle of the petitioner proceeding towards Nanded of Maharashtra State from Hyderabad to dump the rice in an unknown rice mill or further illegal distribution.
It is alleged that when the vehicle of the petitioner was intercepted, it was found that some rice was loaded in the vehicle in various size bags.

On enquiry conducted by the police the lorry driver stated that they collected the rice bags at Katedan and transported the same to Maharashtra and the rice being transported is PDS rice and that the rice stock belongs to Md.Imran resident of Hyderabad and the owner of lorry is Aneel Kumar (petitioner herein and accused No.4).
3.

In view of the assertion made by the petitioner that he is the owner of the vehicle Ashok Ley Land Lorry No.KA 39 8077 and no way concerned with the seized rice, this Court is inclined to grant relief to the petitioner.
4. It is represented by learned Assistant Government Pleader Home that seized vehicle has been deposited before the learned Judicial.

First Class Magistrate, Sangareddy on 10.10.2023 vide Form No.66, vide CPR No.219/15/2023.
BVR,J W.P.No.29650 OF 2023 5.

In view of the same, the writ petition is disposed of giving liberty to the petitioner to submit application under Section 451 Cr.P.C before the learned Judicial First Class Magistrate at Aneel Kumar vs The State Of Telangana, on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123769900/
1 Sangareddy.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate at Aneel Kumar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On such application, being filed, the learned Magistrate shall release the vehicle forthwith on condition of the petitioner furnishing a bank guarantee by way of fixed deposit for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only).

Pending such proceedings, the petitioner is directed not to alienate or alter physical features of the subject vehicle, and is further directed to produce the subject vehicle as and when required by the authorities concerned.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending in this writ petition shall stand closed.
No order as to costs.
